style: Say firmly but kindly, like a ship captain giving clear directions
lines: Welcome to Maple Street. This light follows rules. Every half second it checks them from the top, and the first rule that fits wins.
Press a walk button on the street and watch which rule lights up.
Tap a chip in a rule to change it. Press Add rule to write a new one.
You're the city's new light coder. Each job has a goal. Change the rules, then press Run test.
Tap a line in the report to see that moment on the street.
Job one: Press to Cross. Walkers press the button, but the light never changes. Press Add rule and write the rule that starts it. Then press Run test.
Job two: Don't Skip Yellow. Drivers need a yellow light to stop safely. Fix rule one, and add a rule for yellow. Then press Run test.
Job three: Let Them Finish. The light turns green too soon. Find the rule that does it and change a chip. Then press Run test.
Job four: Rush Hour. Walkers press all the time. Give the cars a fair turn too: long greens, and no long reds. Then press Run test.
Job five: Ambulance! When an ambulance is coming, keep the light green for it. Add a rule, then press Run test.
Test done. Everything was safe, and every goal is met. Job finished.
Test done. There were unsafe moments. The report shows which rule caused each one.
Test done. It was safe, but a goal was missed. Check the report.
Two rules fit at once, and the higher one won. Try moving a rule.
That's every job. Maple Street is safe and fair. Nice work, coder.
Six rules is the most. Change a rule instead.
